finding.title: No check pins the per-step valve_target override of _valve_flow_set
finding.claim: Replacing `if valve_target is not None:` at thermal_model.py:2270 with False survives the full gate; a per-step valve_target of 45 gives flow set-point 51.75 baseline vs 40.25 mutant (configured target 35), 25 gives 28.75 vs 40.25.
finding.mechanism: The per-step target is how a commanded valve holds its charge; no gate script asserts that the plan's lowered/raised valve target changes the simulated flow temperature, so the plan's valve target could be ignored without any check failing.
